title: 24 June 2010: Ringo Starr begins 2010 summer tour
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Casino Rama in Rama, Ontario, Canada, on 24 June 2010.

It was the first show of the 11th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 31 dates between June and August 2010, and the first of two consecutive nights in Rama.

Fans can expect to hear a jukebox worth of classics including Ringo’s ‘It Don’t Come Easy’, ‘Photograph’, ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’, ‘Yellow Submarine’, ‘Octopus’s Garden’ as well as selections from his latest release Y NOT (Hip-O/Ume). Ringo will alternate with hits from the All Starr’s including: ‘Free Ride’, ‘Frankenstein’, ‘Broken Wings’, ‘Kyrie’, ‘Hang On Sloopy’, ‘Rock And Roll, Hoochie Koo’, ‘Dream Weaver’, ‘Talking In Your Sleep’, and ‘What I Like About You’.

The tour kicks off June 24 with two nights at Fallsview Casino in Ontario and 11 shows later, on July 7, Ringo will celebrate his 70th birthday with a ‘Peace & Love’ celebration at noon, followed that evening with a concert at Radio City Music Hall. The North American tour concludes August 7 at Los Angeles’s Greek Theater.

Ringostarr.com

Starr had previously performed at the Casino Rama on 26 July 2001, 24 and 25 July 2003, 14 and 15 June 2006, and 20 June 2008. He returned there on 6 June 2014 and 27 and 28 May 2022.
